subject: t-c-imp
title: T.C.IMP.------RT.DY.
description: Diagram opening R(AS)CM(II)-41 — the section identifying the middle-sixties as the primary time-junction that dictated how alternative-recording's spread could be utilized (Strata East, Jazz Composer's Orchestra). The prose below identifies the structural target: 'the middle sixties as a primary time junction that dictated how the spread of alternative recording could be utilized and made successful.' The crossing diagrams how temporal-continuity-implication structurally meets reality-dynamics at the alternative-recording time-junction scale: T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication — the implication a time-junction carries forward) crossed with RT-DY (reality dynamics — the actual reality-dynamics conditions an alternative-recording effort must meet). T-C-IMP sits on the left with the subject-arrow; EXP-DY (exposure dynamics) sits at top-center and INFO-DY (information dynamics) at upper-right with CULT-AF-B (cultural-affinity base) at the right margin as the upper bridging chain. PER-TR (perceived transition) sits centrally above RT-DY as the bridging hub. RT-DY is partner-axis at center-right; AFTD (affinity transfer-dynamics) at the right with MOT-DY (motion dynamics) below as partner-side downward outputs. TRS (transformation) sits centrally below; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and POL-P (political particulars) anchor the lower-left and lower-center as the subject-side downward chain. Structural argument: when temporal-continuity-implication is crossed with reality-dynamics, the upper diagonal EXP-DY → INFO-DY → CULT-AF-B is the *time-junction route* — exposure-dynamics routes through information-dynamics into cultural-affinity-base, the route through which the middle-sixties primary time-junction reached actual recording-projects. PER-TR → RT-DY is the bridging diagonal that converts the time-junction's perceived-transition into reality-dynamics; without that diagonal, alternative-recording's time-junction remains an implication rather than reality-conditions. The partner-side AFTD → MOT-DY is what reality-dynamics produces alone — affinity-transfer-dynamics into motion-dynamics, the working chain that recording-companies supply. The subject's TRS → PROG-CONT / POL-P chain is what temporal-continuity-implication produces alone — transformation routes through progressional-continuance into political-particulars. The Strata East / Jazz Composer's Orchestra success the prose names is structurally that the upper diagonal *and* the PER-TR bridging diagonal held simultaneously, letting the time-junction's exposure-dynamics actually reach the partner's reality-dynamics through both routes; without both, alternative-recording remains an implication rather than the working solidified-company the prose names.
